page.layout: Two parallel columns of calendar tables: left column (Kalends of April, Idus and Nones of the preceding months) and right column (Kalends of May and the preceding days). Below them, one full-width paragraph of running text, followed by an italic paragraph. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: Vt autem perfecte intelligamus ordinationem Iulianam, sciendum est Cæsarem in quatuor mensibus, scilicet Martio, Maio, Quintili & Octobri vsurpasse sex nonas, in reliquis quatuor. Præterea Cæsar in singulos menses distribuit octo idus: reliquos dies numero kalendarum designauit.

page.notes: The calendar tables are set in two columns with dash leaders; the dash gaps are rendered as " | ". No damage or doubtful readings noted. The text in the lower paragraph is set in a larger type than the tables. The printed "ff" in "vsurpasse" is the printer's double s, rendered as ss.
